author: benshapiro
text:
I asked Ben Shapiro if replacement migration is a problem in America.

Entire communities have been replaced with entirely new foreign enclaves forced on the people who live there.

They are basically new colonies on our shores.

This is not what immigration was supposed to be.

His response: "Mass migration from any population that is culturally non-assimilative to the west is a massive problem. Of course."

"In the early 20th century we had high levels of immigration from Europe... the vast majorty of those people assimilated because there was no gigantic grab bag of cash... We changed the entire system in the 1960s, we opened our borders to people from everywhere and simultaneously said 'free donuts' and if you do that you're going to end up with a different population pretty quickly."

Exactly, @benshapiro.
